title: Workday Analyst
description:
Title: Workday Analyst
Location: New York, NY (remote)
Type: Contract

Our client is seeking Workday Analyst to manage and configure Workday HCM & Recruiting functional areas to meet business requirements.

Key Accountabilities:
  • Collaborates with internal teams and external vendors to ensure seamless integration of HRIS solutions with other business systems. Drives projects to enhance interoperability and data accuracy.
  • Ensures delivery of timely, quality services and meets Service Level Agreements.
  • Leads Workday HCM & Recruiting projects by obtaining key partner agreements, developing requirements, building and testing, preparing plans for change management and go-live, and conducting post-mortem feedback improvements.
  • Partners with other Workday technology leads and business owners to ensure a strong HRIS foundation to support seamless integration of specialized technologies.
  • Leverages extensive experience with Workday to manage and optimize its use within organization. Ensures that Workday and related HR systems meet organizational needs and drive value.
  • Collaborates with leadership to contribute to large cross-functional initiatives and implements system solutions that enables organization to build outstanding experience and support growth.
  • Troubleshoots and resolve system tickets that cannot be solved at the tier 1 level.
  • Supports mass data conversions, transformations, and Workday EIBs.
  • Participates in project planning, management, and execution to ensure successful delivery of Workday projects.
Required Skills:
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems or a related discipline; or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of ten (10) years of experience in HR Technology, with at least five (5) years in Workday HCM configuration.
  • A minimum of three (3) years of experience in Workday Recruiting configuration.
  • Workday Questionnaire experience.
  • Workday implementation experience and relevant certifications are preferred.
  • Experience with writing Workday reports is preferred.
  • Experience with Workday HiredScore is preferred.
  • Detail-oriented with strong ethics and integrity.
  • Strong technical aptitude and an analytical mindset with the ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities with accuracy, efficiency, and timeliness due to strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to partner with other team members to achieve results.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of HR and Talent Acquisition business processes, systems, and best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Technical Program Manager IV
description:
Title: Technical Program Manager IV
Location: Philadelphia, PA
Type: Contract

Our client is seeking a Technical Program Manager IV who will be responsible for managing one or more highly complex or enterprise-wide IT program(s) consisting of multiple projects.

This is a single or multiple incumbent(s) position that typically exists in a small to medium size enterprise with multiple project managers, project leaders, and/or project support staff as direct or dotted line reports.

Key Accountabilities:
  • Develops the program strategy, supporting business case and various enterprise-wide high-level project plans.
  • Ensures integration of projects and adjusts project scope, timing, and budgets as needed, based on the needs of the business.
  • Communicates with IT leadership, business leadership and IT Business Consultants to communicate program strategy, direction, and changes.
  • Responsible for delivering all projects contained in the IT project portfolio on time, within budget and meeting the strategic and business requirements.
  • Responsible for tracking key project milestones and recommending adjustments to Project Managers.
  • Partners with senior leadership of the business community to identify and prioritize opportunities for utilizing IT to achieve the goals of the enterprise.
  • Manages resources, monitors progress, mitigates risks, and communicates effectively with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Connects with cross-functional teams as necessary.
  • Provides updates to key stakeholders.
  • Creates project-related content.
  • Contributes to presentations as needed.

Required Skills:
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or other related field; or equivalent work experience.
  • Typically has 10 to 15 years of IT and business/industry work experience, with at least 3 years of experience in a leadership role and 8+ years managing projects.
  • Must possess extensive knowledge and expertise in the use of Project Management methodologies and tools.
  • Experience in technical and cross-functional project management.
  • Ability to manage multiple sub-projects and teams.
  • Experience with setting up and tracking projects for success, monitoring deadlines, and evaluating project performance.
  • Experience with creating budgets.
  • Excellent writing skills in order to create descriptive and project tracking content.
  • Experience with typical program management tools.
  • Experience with Agile methodology and ability to determine where applicable.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to interact with numerous teams.
  • Ability to identify opportunities for process improvement or for improving efficiency.

title: Technical Project Manager II - UX
description:
Title: Technical Project Manager II - UX
Location: Philadelphia, PA
Type: Contract
 
 
Our client is looking for a Project Manager II who will be responsible for working with cross-functional teams and various levels across the organization to drive project deliverables. This role will be working on a large-scale project with milestones as part of the Global Design team covering TV, mobile, and web devices. Familiarity with the flow / process of design is preferred.
 
This is a hybrid role, on site in Philadelphia 3-4 days per week.
 
 
Key Accountabilities:
 
  • Responsible for overall coordination, status reporting, and stability of project-oriented work efforts.
  • Facilitates meetings within different organizations including Product Engineering and Design.
  • Sets timelines and milestones.
  • Develops resource management awareness with the leads of teams to identify any gaps and find coverage.
  • Establishes and implements project management processes and methodologies for the IT community to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, adhere to high quality standards and meet customer expectations.
  • Responsible for assembling project plans and teamwork assignments, directing and monitoring work efforts on a daily basis, identifying resource needs, performing quality review, and escalating functional, quality, timeline issues appropriately.
  • Responsible for tracking key project milestones and adjusting project plans and/or resources to meet the needs of customers. Coordinates communication with all areas of the enterprise that impacts the scope, budget, risk, and resources of the work effort being managed.
  • Assists Program Manager(s) in partnering with senior management of the business community to identify and prioritize opportunities for utilizing IT to achieve the goals of the enterprise.
  • Manages one or more cross-functional projects of medium to high complexity.
  • Coordinates tasks between various teams, develops processes, resolves issues, and ensures team and customers receive required information and documentation to perform their responsibilities.
  • Responsible for managing deliverables and communicating with application teams to meet project deadlines.
  • Responsible for initiating and tracking communications among customers. Provides feedback to teams to facilitate continuous improvement.
  • Manages and leads complex projects through entire project lifecycle (inception, design, development, integration and test, trial, and deployment).
  • Creates and tracks an end-to-end project plan (in conjunction with the scrum master and team leads).
  • Leads change request generation and tracking.
  • Identifies and manages critical path and risk areas, and create risk response and mitigation plans.
  • Communicates statuses on progress, risks, and issues.
  • Works with management to maintain the project specific budget.
 
Required Skills:
 
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or other related field; or equivalent work experience.
  • Project Management certification or successful completion of a recognized project management curriculum is required.
  • Typically has 5 to 7 years of IT work experience, including 5 or more years managing projects. Experience with projects in multiple technologies and functions.
  • Must possess extensive knowledge and expertise in the use of project management methodologies and tools, resource management practices and change management techniques.
  • Experience with program management and experience working within the design field / technology are preferred.
  • Ability to identify risk and communicate it proactively.
  • Agile or Kanban experience preferred.
  • Experience with Jira and Smartsheet preferred.

description:

Location: Philadelphia, PA (remote or hybrid)
Type: Contract

Our client is seeking a Healthcare IS Project Manager III who has a solid background in project management with experience in business applications and operations in a hospital environment.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Exhibits advanced skills in estimating and the use of project management productivity tools.
